content.comment_body: I understand that S7-TCP and Modbus are distinct communication methods, but I am interested in learning which one might be preferable and how they differ when it comes to transferring signals. I am looking to connect a [product_name] device with a NODE-RED server running on a Raspberry Pi, and I am trying to decide whether S7-TCP or Modbus-TCP would be the best option.
From my perspective, using Ethernet TCP/IP with the S7 protocol tends to be a more straightforward approach.
